name: Abdus Sattar
contribution: He headed the elected civilian government that Ershad overthrew in 1982, representing a fragile attempt to stabilize constitutional rule after the Zia era.
impact: His removal highlighted how weak elected institutions remained in the face of military power.
highlight: Abdus Sattar's elected government was overthrown by Ershad's 1982 military coup.
seoTitle: Abdus Sattar: Bangladesh's Elected President before 1982
seoDescription: Learn about President Abdus Sattar's brief civilian tenure and the 1982 military coup that ended it.
shortAnswer: Abdus Sattar was Bangladesh's president whose elected civilian government was overthrown in the 1982 coup.
